note: Edit this file (and push to the pipeline-config branch) to start a new batch: change batch, branch, targets and scope_from, and create the research branch with _drafts/<batch>/{news,updates,blog}/ first.
PRIORITY_INSTRUCTION_FOCUS: FOR THE BLOG ROUTINE ONLY: this batch's 5 guides are the entries at the top of origin/pipeline-config:pipeline/query-queue.json that carry a region field (WB or UP), priority A. Use each id as the slug, its query as the basis of the title, its angle as the scope and its verify field as the statutes and cases to confirm from two sources. Answer the question directly in the first paragraph, as on today's date, then statute, forum, time limits and procedure; say where State law differs or is unsettled; link related existing guides by name. Where a State rule, rate or notification cannot be confirmed from an official or reliable source, say it varies and omit the figure. Skip any entry whose subject already exists on origin/main or origin/stage-batch12. practice_area: 'Property & Civil Litigation' or 'Commercial Litigation'. BCI Rule 36: educational only; the page may name the court or forum in the city (for example Calcutta High Court, Gautam Buddha Nagar district court) because the law requires it, but NEVER frame it as 'lawyers/advocates/law firm in <city>', no call to contact the firm, no 'we can help', no fee or consultation wording, no claims of results, experience or clients.
NEWS_UPDATES_NOTE: For news and updates: real, dated rulings and notifications from SCOPE_FROM. Of the 5 items each, at least 3 must concern courts, tribunals or authorities serving Uttar Pradesh (Allahabad High Court, Gautam Buddha Nagar / Noida, UP RERA, NOIDA/GNIDA, NCLT Allahabad) or West Bengal (Calcutta High Court, Kolkata tribunals, WBRERA, KMC, NCLT Kolkata, CESTAT Kolkata), or Supreme Court appeals from those States; the rest may be national. Spread across practice areas; no duplicates of anything live or staged. Educational reporting only (BCI Rule 36).
